cohort: 413,892 parturient women from 22 monitoring hospitals in Hebei Province, China, from January 1, 2013, to December 31, 2021.
finding: The incidence of pregnancy complications, including anemia, GDM, PE, placental abruption, cesarean delivery, premature delivery, SGA, LGA, and macrosomia, increased in Hebei Province after the implementation of the 2016 Chinese second-child policy, particularly among women of advanced maternal age (≥ 35 years old).
